strategy: semantic-home migration; preserve data, replace duplicated ownership with references

overlap_resolutions.partner_spouse_vs_romantic_relationships: Represent the other person once; encode partner/spouse as relationship type and spouse/partner obligations as roles where applicable.
overlap_resolutions.income_wealth_vs_material_resources: Economic amounts and ownership live in education_work_economy; current usability/availability is referenced by resources_constraints_opportunities.
overlap_resolutions.housing_context_vs_household_context: Residence/place relation stores where and what dwelling; context_ecology stores environmental conditions; household membership is a relationship graph.
overlap_resolutions.relational_patterns_vs_relationship_qual: Personality stores dispositions; relationships store observed or relationship-specific quality.
overlap_resolutions.sleep_vs_sleep_routine: Health stores sleep functioning/impairment; lifestyle stores recurring sleep behavior.
overlap_resolutions.social_resources_vs_support_network: Relationships define people/ties; resources references the subset currently available as support.
overlap_resolutions.work_roles_vs_employment_status: Employment/organization relation stores labour participation; roles stores obligations and role identity.
overlap_resolutions.historical_period_vs_historical_events: Development stores cohort/life-course placement; life_events/context references historical processes affecting the person.

legacy_policy.diagnosis_ontology.json: retain; mount as psychiatric_diagnosis domain module
legacy_policy.archetype_grid: retain; classify as narrative_identity generative model, not psychometric or diagnostic truth
legacy_policy.events: retain; migrate to typed process_event records
legacy_policy.flat_persona_fields: retain through adapter until Persona Kernel v2 is production default
